summary: Enhance your skills with our ICT for Monitoring and Evaluation training course. Learn effective techniques to improve project outcomes and data analysis.
lede: ICT for monitoring and evaluation uses digital workflows to collect, manage, analyze, and communicate programme evidence. For M&E managers, evaluation specialists, programme officers, and data managers, the course addresses how to build reliable digital workflows from programme frameworks. You practise defining indicators, configuring and validating digital surveys, assessing data quality, and creating dashboards to support analysis and reporting.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-to-advanced course suits professionals responsible for designing, operating, governing, or using digital monitoring and evaluation systems across programmes and portfolios.
modules: Results-Based Management and Theory of Change
prerequisites: Working knowledge of programme monitoring, evaluation terminology, indicators, and routine reporting is recommended. No programming experience is required. You should bring a laptop and, where possible, a sample indicator list or anonymized dataset. Advanced concepts such as APIs, AI-assisted anomaly review, and DHIS2 interoperability are taught at conceptual and operational application level, not production engineering level.
